title: vepris elliotii
intro: Vepris elliotii, commonly known as the yellow ironwood, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in West African folk medicine for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections. The health benefits of Vepris elliotii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been isolated and characterized from the plant's leaves and roots.
